contests.title: Sumner-Fredericksburg Community School District — School improvement bonds

provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the Sumner-Fredericksburg Community School District in the Counties of Bremer, Chickasaw, and Fayette, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $16,300,000 to provide funds to construct, build, furnish, and equip additions to the High School building; and to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the existing High School, Middle School, and Fredericksburg Elementary buildings, including playground, parking, and site improvements?

contests.title: Keota Community School District — Measure ML: School improvement bonds

provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the Keota Community School District in the Counties of Keokuk and Washington, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $6,400,000 to provide funds to remodel, repair, equip, and improve the Jr-Sr High School, including a secure entrance, educational spaces, HVAC, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing improvements; to remodel, repair, equip, and improve the Elementary School, including a secure entrance and plumbing improvements; and for fire alarm upgrades throughout the school building?

contests.title: Pekin Community School District — Measure MN: School improvement bonds

provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the Pekin Community School District in the Counties of Jefferson, Keokuk, Wapello, and Washington, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $9,200,000 to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip additions to the school building, including classroom and commons area spaces; to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the school building, including a secure entrance, HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, parking, accessibility, and site improvements?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $16.3 million in general-obligation bonds for high school additions and renovations, repairs and equipment at the high school, middle school and Fredericksburg Elementary, including playground, parking and site improvements.

Authorizes up to $6.4 million in general-obligation bonds for junior-senior high school renovations, including a secure entrance, educational spaces and heating, cooling, mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems; elementary school secure entrance and plumbing work; and fire alarm upgrades.

Authorizes up to $9.2 million in general-obligation bonds for school additions with classrooms and common areas, renovations and equipment, a secure entrance, heating, cooling, mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, parking, accessibility and site improvements.
